items.title: Biodiversity credits hold promise, yet credit-generating protocols require safeguards to realize potential
items.title_en: Biodiversity credits hold promise, yet credit-generating protocols require safeguards to realize potential
items.title_zh: 生物多样性信用机制前景广阔，但要充分发挥其潜力，信用生成方案仍需建立相应的保障措施
items.summary_en: Given the existing gap in biodiversity funding, mobilizing private finance will be essential to achieving global biodiversity conservation goals, especially across lower- and middle-income countries with limited capacity and public finance. The emerging voluntary biodiversity market (VBM) holds promise to leverage private finance for biodiversity, but credit-generating protocols must be robust to prevent greenwashing and maximize effectiveness. In this study, the first to move beyond theoretical critiques and general market assessments of the VBM, we extracted details of program structure and crediting issuance from protocols for 13 relatively well-established biodiversity-crediting organizations. With these data, we evaluated protocols’ alignment with both conservation and restoration biology principles and lessons learned from the voluntary carbon market (VCM). We find that action must be taken to improve quantification of biodiversity impacts, especially incorporating patch size and connectivity in crediting and assessing projects on ecologically relevant timelines. Further, safeguards for additionality, leakage, risk, and verification from the VCM must be more robustly integrated in the VBM, and deep engagement and investment in local communities must be improved to ensure durable biodiversity-positive outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 鉴于当前生物多样性资金缺口，调动私人资本对于实现全球生物多样性保护目标至关重要，特别是在能力有限且公共财政资源匮乏的中低收入国家。新兴的自愿性生物多样性市场（VBM）有望为生物多样性保护撬动私人资本，但信用生成协议必须足够健全，以防止“洗绿”行为并最大限度地提高成效。 本研究是首项超越对自愿生物多样性市场（VBM）的理论批判和一般性市场评估的研究，我们从13家相对成熟的生物多样性信用组织的工作方案中，提取了项目结构和信用额度发放的详细信息。 基于这些数据，我们评估了这些协议与保护和恢复生物学原则以及自愿碳市场（VCM）经验教训的一致性。我们发现，必须采取行动改进生物多样性影响的量化工作，特别是将斑块大小和连通性纳入信用核算，并在生态相关的时限内评估项目。 此外，必须将自愿碳市场（VCM）中关于额外性、泄漏、风险和核查的保障措施更牢固地融入生物多样性碳信用市场（VBM），并加强与当地社区的深度互动及投资，以确保实现持久的、对生物多样性有利的成果。

items.title: Spatially distributed air quality and health impacts of data center electricity demand in the United States
items.title_en: Spatially distributed air quality and health impacts of data center electricity demand in the United States
items.title_zh: 美国数据中心电力需求对空气质量及健康影响的空间分布
items.summary_en: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence is driving substantial growth in electricity demand from data centers in the US, yet how the resulting air quality and public health impacts are distributed remain poorly quantified. To trace the ambient air pollution and associated premature mortality impacts of grid-supplied data center electricity demand in 2023, we couple the United States Electricity Generation Optimization model with the GEOS-Chem chemical transport model. We compare hourly, unit-level electricity dispatch with and without data center demand to quantify changes in power-sector emissions, ambient PM and ozone, and associated premature mortality. Our results show that electricity generation attributable to data center demand is largely supplied by fossil fuel units across multiple regions, resulting in additional annual mean PM concentrations of 0.02–0.08 g m (local peak concentrations up to 0.2 g m ), and regionally varying ozone responses characterized by wintertime depletion and summertime enhancement. These impacts are most pronounced in the Midwest United States, where marginal emissions from coal-fired units and ammonia-rich atmospheric conditions enhance secondary particulate formation. We estimate that this grid-supplied demand is responsible for 513 (95% CI: 469–557) annual premature mortalities from PM and an additional 137 (95% CI: 90–183) annually from maximum daily 8 h average ozone (MDA8- ) in the contiguous US. State-level analysis reveals a systematic geographic mismatch: states hosting the largest data center loads do not necessarily experience the highest attributable mortality rates, while some states with little data center demand bear substantial burdens. This mismatch arises because of dispatch across interconnected electricity regions, regional differences in generation and emissions, and atmospheric chemistry and transport, which together separate the locations of demand from those of exposure and mortality. These findings highlight the importance of considering both air quality impacts and their spatial distribution in data center and macro-energy system planning.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能的迅猛发展正推动美国数据中心的电力需求大幅增长，但由此产生的空气质量和公共健康影响的分布情况仍缺乏充分量化。 为了追踪2023年电网供电的数据中心用电需求对环境空气污染及相关过早死亡的影响，我们将“美国发电优化模型”与“GEOS-Chem化学传输模型”相结合。 我们对比了包含和不包含数据中心用电需求情况下的每小时、机组级电力调度情况，以量化电力行业排放、环境中的PM和臭氧浓度变化，以及相关的过早死亡人数。 研究结果表明，多个地区因数据中心需求产生的发电量主要由化石燃料机组提供，导致年平均PM浓度增加0.02–0.08 g m（局部峰值浓度高达0.2 g m），且各地区臭氧响应存在差异，其特征为冬季浓度下降、夏季浓度升高。 这些影响在美国中西部最为显著，该地区燃煤机组的边际排放量以及富含氨的大气条件加剧了二次颗粒物的形成。我们估算，该电网供电需求每年导致513例（95%置信区间： 469–557）例，此外，在美利坚合众国本土48州，每日最高8小时平均臭氧浓度（MDA8-）每年还导致额外137（95%置信区间：90–183）例过早死亡。 州级分析揭示了一种系统性的地理错配：承载最大数据中心负荷的州并不一定面临最高的归因死亡率，而一些数据中心需求较小的州却承受着沉重的负担。 这种不匹配源于互联电力区域间的调度、各区域在发电和排放方面的差异，以及大气化学和传输过程，这些因素共同导致了需求发生地与暴露及死亡发生地之间的分离。这些发现……

items.title: Effects of high elevation wildfires on peak snow water equivalent in California’s Sierra Nevada headwater regions
items.title_en: Effects of high elevation wildfires on peak snow water equivalent in California’s Sierra Nevada headwater regions
items.title_zh: 高海拔森林火灾对加利福尼亚州内华达山脉源头地区峰值积雪水当量的影响
items.summary_en: Increases in high‐elevation wildfires in California’s Sierra Nevada region (SNR) have raised concerns about potential impacts on snowpack, a major source for the state’s water supply. Quantifying fire-induced changes in snow storage remains challenging in mountainous regions with complex topography and large climatic and ecological gradients, due to limited field observations and process models. This study leveraged high-resolution airborne snow observatory lidar surveys (2023–2024) to assess the impacts of 2020–2021 wildfires on peak snow water equivalent (SWE) across six SNR watersheds. We assembled >32000 matched burned-unburned 50 m pixel pairs with similar pre-fire environmental conditions and assessed how changes in peak SWE (ΔpeakSWE: burned—unburned) varied with burn severity, pre-fire forest structure, meteorological variables, and terrain above the snowline. Across matched pairs, post-fire peak SWE differences varied in both magnitude and direction, depending on yearly weather (e.g. wet vs. normal year) and local environmental setting. The largest positive burned–unburned difference occurred in dense forests with ⩾75% canopy loss at intermediate elevations in 2023, where burned areas had 13.0 cm higher peak SWE on average (12% relative to the matched unburned mean of 105.1 cm); this difference was substantially smaller in 2024. The spatially cross-validated extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) machine learning model showed terrain provided the strongest predictive information, followed by vegetation structure. SHapley Additive exPlanations and a shallow decision tree further showed that sites with lower heat exposure, locally lower terrain positions, and intermediate elevations generally were associated with higher peak SWE in burned areas compared to matched unburned areas, whereas taller pre-fire canopies and exposed, high-energy terrain were associated with lower peak SWE. These results demonstrate wildfire effects on peak SWE are strongly context dependent and provide an assessment framework for anticipating where high elevation wildfires may increase or reduce mountain snow storage.
items.summary_zh: 加利福尼亚州内华达山脉地区（SNR）高海拔野火的增多，引发了人们对积雪可能受到影响的担忧——积雪是该州供水的主要来源。 在地形复杂、气候和生态梯度较大的山区，由于实地观测和过程模型的局限性，量化火灾引起的积雪储量变化仍具挑战性。 本研究利用高分辨率机载雪观测站激光雷达测绘数据（2023–2024年），评估了2020–2021年野火对内华达山脉地区六个流域峰值积雪水当量（SWE）的影响。 我们汇集了超过32000组环境条件相似的“过火区—未过火区”50米像素配对数据，并评估了峰值雪水当量变化（ΔpeakSWE：过火区—未过火区）如何随过火强度、火灾前森林结构、气象变量以及雪线以上地形的变化而变化。 在配对数据中，火灾后峰值SWE的差异在幅度和方向上均存在变化，这取决于当年的天气状况（例如多雨年与常年）以及当地的环境条件。 2023年，在中等海拔地区，冠层损失率≥75%的密林中出现了最大的正向“烧过—未烧过”差异，该区域烧过地的峰值雪水当量平均高出13.0厘米（相对于匹配未烧过地的平均值105.1厘米，增幅为12%）； 而在2024年，这一差异则显著缩小。经过空间交叉验证的极端梯度提升（XGBoost）机器学习模型表明，地形提供了最强的预测信息，其次是植被结构。 夏普利加性解释（SHapley Additive exPlanations）和浅层决策树进一步表明，与匹配的未烧区域相比，热暴露较低、局部地形位置较低且海拔处于中等的地点，其烧毁区域的峰值雪水当量通常较高；而火灾前树冠较高以及暴露、高能的地形则与较低的峰值雪水当量相关。 这些结果表明，野火对峰值土壤水当量（SWE）的影响在很大程度上取决于具体情境。

items.summary_en: Deep beneath the Pacific Ocean, scientists have discovered tiny hidden ecosystems inside metal-rich rocks that take millions of years to form. Researchers examined 244 nodules and found more than 4,100 animals living in their cracks and cavities, including unique communities unlike those in the surrounding seafloor mud. These remarkable miniature habitats could now be threatened by deep-sea mining for valuable metals.
items.summary_zh: 在太平洋深处，科学家们在富含金属的岩石内部发现了微小的隐蔽生态系统，这些岩石的形成历经数百万年。 研究人员对244个结核进行了考察，发现其裂缝和空隙中栖息着4,100余种动物，其中包括与周围海底泥层中截然不同的独特生物群落。如今，这些非凡的微型栖息地可能正面临着深海采矿活动对贵金属开采的威胁。

items.title: Resilience as a governing principle in water governance

items.title_zh: 韧性作为水治理的基本原则
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01972-yWater governance often treats resilience as an end state, achieved mainly through technocratic decision-making and standard engineering tools. Drawing on five international cases, we argue that resilience should instead guide governance design and operation through adaptability, coordination, learning and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 《自然·可持续性》（Nature Sustainability），在线发表于：2026年11月17日；doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01972-y 水治理往往将韧性视为一种最终状态，主要通过技术官僚式的决策和标准工程工具来实现。 基于五个国际案例，我们认为，韧性应通过适应性、协调性、学习能力和问责制来指导治理的设计与运作。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01945-1Millions of people share rivers, aquifers and coastlines with mining operations, but years of regulation and voluntary schemes have left these communities with limited knowledge of what water is withdrawn, discharged or contaminated.
